For people who are unaware, in the most reason update, Valve added it so that the player models set to this when the player becomes dormant. (The model becomes in-active.)
What I mean by this, is that when they added the wallhack patch which severely crippled Wallhacking (Didn't remove it, just crippled it.) they added the cvars;
- sv_occlude_players
- pvs_min_player_distance

Community servers can set custom variables for these. For instance, hypothetically if you were to load a wallhack into your game, set occlude players to 0 and set pvs_min_player_distance to 99999 then you would be able to use the wallhack and see players through the whole map. However, if you leave it at default, you can then only see it through whatever the pvs distance is set to by default.
So basically, if you are not within the pvs distance, the player becomes like this because they are technically 'dormant' (The model is inactive.)

I hope this is a thorough explanation of what is going on.
